environments.name: Orbital Station (LEO)
environments.escalation_note: Real-time telemetry link active. Coordinate with Flight Surgeon on ground loop for persistent watch items or urgent alerts.

environments.name: Deep Space Transit
environments.escalation_note: Delayed Earth communication (up to 20 min one-way). Execute onboard Crew Medical Officer protocol immediately while transmitting telemetry.

environments.name: Lunar Surface Base
environments.escalation_note: Near-real-time lunar relay (2.6s). Log anomaly in medical binder and review with Artemis Flight Surgeon.

environments.name: Mars Surface Habitat
environments.escalation_note: High Earth latency (up to 48 min round-trip). Begin autonomous medical countermeasures immediately and queue full packet for Earth review.

indicators.name: Blood Pressure
indicators.description: Brachial systolic and diastolic pressure measured seated or tethered at rest.

messages.normal: Blood pressure is within healthy mission bounds.
messages.watch: Blood pressure is trending outside optimal range; recheck after 15 minutes of rest.
messages.alert: Blood pressure is in an urgent cardiovascular threshold band.

watch: Repeat seated resting blood pressure in 15 min
Verify hydration and electrolyte intake
alert: Pause strenuous EVA/exercise and rest immediately
Repeat reading twice 5 min apart and notify Crew Medical Officer

indicators.name: Resting Heart Rate
indicators.description: Morning resting pulse rate prior to resistive exercise or caffeine.

messages.normal: Resting heart rate reflects stable autonomic conditioning.
messages.watch: Resting heart rate is mildly outside baseline conditioning range.
messages.alert: Resting heart rate indicates significant cardiac or orthostatic strain.

watch: Hydrate with 500 mL electrolyte solution
Check orthostatic tolerance before high-load tasks
alert: Record 12-lead/portable ECG strip immediately
Suspend vigorous exercise until evaluated

indicators.name: Blood Oxygen (SpO2)
indicators.description: Peripheral capillary oxygen saturation via pulse oximeter, critical during suit pre-breathe.

messages.normal: Oxygen saturation is normal for cabin and pre-breathe operations.
messages.watch: Mild desaturation detected; verify cabin ppO2 and sensor fit.
messages.alert: Hypoxia threshold breached; immediate oxygen and cabin atmosphere check required.

watch: Warm finger and re-seat pulse oximeter sensor
Check cabin O2 and CO2 partial pressure scrubbers
alert: Administer supplemental O2 per cabin emergency protocol
Verify cabin pressure and CO2 scrubber telemetry immediately

indicators.name: Blood Glucose
indicators.description: Fasting or pre-meal capillary blood glucose concentration.

messages.normal: Blood glucose is balanced within target metabolic range.
messages.watch: Glucose is mildly outside target fasting range; review meal timing.
messages.alert: Blood glucose is in a critical hypo/hyperglycemic threshold.

watch: Log timing relative to last meal and recheck before next shift
Ensure balanced carbohydrate and protein intake
alert: If <65 mg/dL, consume 15g fast-acting carbohydrates and recheck in 15 min
Avoid solo operations or EVA until glucose stabilizes

indicators.name: Body Mass
indicators.description: Weekly orbital/planetary mass measurement compared against pre-flight baseline.

messages.normal: Body mass remains within ±3% of pre-flight baseline.
messages.watch: Body mass has shifted 3-5% from pre-flight baseline.
messages.alert: Body mass has deviated >=5% from pre-flight baseline, risking lean mass loss.

watch: Audit daily caloric and protein intake over the last 7 days
Add nutrient-dense supplemental rations
alert: Initiate structured nutrition recovery plan with higher caloric target
Review food acceptability and hydration logs

indicators.name: Intraocular Pressure
indicators.description: Weekly tonometry reading to screen for Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS).

messages.normal: Intraocular pressure is within normal ocular perfusion limits.
messages.watch: Elevated intraocular pressure trend; monitor for visual shifts.
messages.alert: High intraocular pressure requiring immediate SANS imaging protocol.

watch: Schedule repeat tonometry and Amsler grid check in 24 hours
Review B-complex vitamin supplementation compliance
alert: Perform OCT / fundoscope retinal scan immediately
Consider thigh-cuff or lower-body negative pressure countermeasures per protocol

indicators.name: Resistive & Aerobic Exercise
indicators.description: Daily resistive (ARED) and aerobic exercise duration evaluated on a 7-day rolling mean.

messages.normal: 7-day exercise volume meets bone and muscle countermeasure targets.
messages.watch: 7-day average exercise duration is below optimal 90 min/day target.
messages.alert: 7-day exercise deficit risks accelerated bone density and muscle loss.

watch: Schedule full resistive + cycle ergometer block in next shift
Verify Vitamin D and calcium intake
alert: Prioritize daily resistive countermeasure session immediately
Adjust mission timeline to protect mandatory exercise blocks

indicators.name: Daily Sleep
indicators.description: Restorative sleep hours logged from actigraphy or sleep diary, evaluated on 7-day mean.

messages.normal: 7-day sleep average supports circadian stability and cognitive readiness.
messages.watch: Sleep duration is drifting from the 6.5-9.5 hr restorative window.
messages.alert: Chronic sleep deficit detected (<5.5 hrs 7-day mean), impairing mission safety.

watch: Enforce blue-light hygiene 90 min before sleep cycle
Review cabin noise and thermal comfort
alert: Defer non-critical high-risk operations and schedule recovery sleep
Use circadian lighting protocol and alert Crew Medical Officer

indicators.name: Mood & Stress Resilience
indicators.description: Self-assessed behavioral well-being score (1 = severe distress, 10 = optimal morale).

messages.normal: Behavioral mood and isolation resilience are steady.
messages.watch: Mild behavioral strain detected over the past 7 days.
messages.alert: Significant behavioral distress trend requiring supportive intervention.

watch: Schedule private family/ground audio-video conference
Take structured leisure or VEGGIE habitat care break
alert: Initiate private behavioral health check-in with Crew Medical Officer
Redistribute workload and prioritize restorative crew support

indicators.name: Core Body Temperature
indicators.description: Tympanic or oral body temperature to detect early infection or thermal strain.

messages.normal: Body temperature is within normal thermoregulatory range.
messages.watch: Borderline temperature shift; monitor for immune or thermal triggers.
messages.alert: Febrile or hypothermic threshold reached; isolate source and assess crew.

watch: Recheck temperature in 4 hours and verify cabin thermal loop
Increase fluid intake and log any emerging symptoms
alert: Collect saliva/swab sample for immune and microbial screening
Begin fever/hypothermia protocol and restrict close crew contact

indicators.name: Weekly Radiation Dose
indicators.description: Personal neutron/ionizing dosimeter reading (EVARM / CANS spectrometer).

messages.normal: Weekly ionizing and neutron dose is within nominal mission shielding limits.
messages.watch: Elevated weekly radiation exposure; monitor solar particle alerts.
messages.alert: High radiation exposure threshold exceeded; shelter protocol required.

watch: Inspect personal dosimeter placement and cabin water-wall shielding
Defer non-essential unshielded cupola/EVA time
alert: Move to storm-shelter shielded habitat volume immediately
Log cumulative career dose and notify Radiation Safety Officer

symptoms.name: Near-Vision Blur / Visual Shift
symptoms.description: Hyperopic shift or floaters linked to cephalad fluid shift (SANS).

symptoms.name: Persistent Headache / Head Fullness
symptoms.description: Frontal pressure or persistent headache in microgravity or high CO2.

symptoms.name: Vestibular Dizziness / Gait Shift
symptoms.description: Motion sickness or sensorimotor coordination difficulty during gravity transitions.

symptoms.name: Skin Rash / Viral Reactivation
symptoms.description: Dermatitis or latent herpesvirus reactivation driven by spaceflight immune changes.

symptoms.name: Joint / Decompression Ache
symptoms.description: Deep joint pain following EVA pressure transitions or heavy resistive loading.

symptoms.name: Persistent Fatigue / Lethargy
symptoms.description: Cumulative tiredness affecting reaction time and checklist accuracy.

symptoms.name: Appetite Loss / Food Fatigue
symptoms.description: Reduced food acceptability risking caloric deficit and micronutrient loss.

badges.name: 3-Day Orbit Streak
badges.description: Log health check-ins on 3 consecutive UTC days.

badges.name: Full System Sweep
badges.description: Measure every active indicator in the catalog at least once.

badges.name: Weekly Countermeasure Check
badges.description: Log all weekly indicators (Body Mass, IOP, Radiation Dose).

badges.name: Clean Bill of Health
badges.description: Review and clear active symptoms during a check-in.
